page.payrollDescription: Simulated payroll — configure pay inputs, run a closed month, inspect every line, then finalize.
page.myPayslipsDescription: Your simulated payroll payslips. Amounts are in your organization’s payroll currency; superseded payslips stay available for your records.

runs.title: Payroll runs
runs.description: A closed month becomes timesheets and provisional payslips, then issues on finalize. A correction run supersedes an earlier finalized month.
runs.empty: No payroll runs yet. Start one after the month closes and its salaries are in place.
runs.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every run field.
runs.label: Payroll runs
runs.containerLabel: Payroll runs. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

runForm.title: Start payroll run
runForm.description: A run covers one whole calendar month and can only start after it has ended. Calculation happens in the background.
runForm.monthHint: Closed months only, in YYYY-MM form.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: The tenant-wide inputs every simulated payroll run uses: currency, working hours and the overtime rate.
config.currencyHint: One currency for the whole tenant.
config.standardHoursHint: Used to derive the hourly rate.
config.formula: Overtime pay = verified hours × (base salary ÷ standard monthly hours) × overtime multiplier.
config.viewOnly: View only — Finance, Admin and Super Admin configure payroll.

deductions.title: Deduction lines
deductions.description: Tenant-wide rules, itemised on every payslip. Inactive lines are kept for history and appear on no payslip.
deductions.empty: No deduction lines yet. Add the rules that should itemise on every payslip.
deductions.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every deduction field.
deductions.label: Deduction lines
deductions.containerLabel: Deduction lines. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

deductionForm.description: Every active line lands on every payslip of the run as its own inspectable line.
deductionForm.codeHintEdit: The code is fixed once created.
deductionForm.name: Name
deductionForm.nameHint: Shown to readers of the payslip.
deductionForm.statusHint: Inactive lines appear on no payslip.

salary.title: Salary records
salary.description: Append-only effective dates. A run uses the record effective on its last day; a new record never rewrites history.
salary.empty: No salary records yet. Add one for each employee before running payroll.
salary.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every salary field.
salary.label: Salary records
salary.containerLabel: Salary records. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.
salary.employeeHint: Names come from the employee directory.
salary.employeeIdHint: Paste the employee’s UUID from the employee record.
salary.amountHint: In the tenant currency. No proration on runs.
salary.effectiveHint: One record per employee and date.

bonus.title: Add bonus
bonus.description: The bonus joins this run’s next calculation. Recalculate after adding it to see the updated payslips.
bonus.noPayslips: This run has no payslips yet, so there is no employee to bonus.
bonus.selectEmployee: Select an employee in this run
bonus.noteHint: Stored with the bonus, never shown on the payslip.

runDetail.title: Payroll run
runDetail.description: Simulated payroll — timesheets, payslip lines and totals for one run.
runDetail.notFound: This payroll run doesn’t exist or you don’t have access to it.
runDetail.loadError: Could not load this payroll run.
runDetail.finalizeHint: Finalize becomes available once the calculation finishes.
runDetail.viewOnly: View only — Finance, Admin and Super Admin run payroll.
runDetail.failed: The calculation job failed. Recalculate the run to try again.
runDetail.failedGeneric: The calculation didn’t finish. Recalculate the run to try again.
runDetail.skippedTitle: {count, plural, one {# employee skipped} other {# employees skipped}}
runDetail.skippedDescription: No salary record was effective by the period end, so no payslip was created.
runDetail.timesheetsDescription: Worked hours, HR-verified overtime and approved leave. Informational only — base pay is never prorated.
runDetail.timesheetsFailed: Recalculate the run to produce timesheets.
runDetail.timesheetsPending: Timesheets appear after the calculation finishes.
runDetail.timesheetsSwipe: Swipe sideways to see every timesheet field.
runDetail.timesheetsContainer: Run timesheets. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.
runDetail.payslipsDescription: Every payslip is provisional until finalize. A correction run marks the earlier set superseded, still readable.
runDetail.payslipsFailed: Recalculate the run to produce payslips.
runDetail.payslipsPending: Payslips appear after the calculation finishes.
runDetail.payslipsSwipe: Swipe sideways to see every payslip field.
runDetail.payslipsContainer: Run payslips. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.
runDetail.finalizeDescription: Finalizing issues every payslip and can’t be undone. A correction run is the only way to change this month afterwards.

payslipDetail.title: Payslip
payslipDetail.description: Simulated payroll — every line that makes up your net pay.
payslipDetail.notFound: This payslip doesn’t exist or you don’t have access to it.
payslipDetail.currencyNote: Amounts are in your organization’s payroll currency.
payslipDetail.supersededBody: A later correction run replaced it. It stays available for your records.
payslipDetail.deductionsDescription: Every active tenant rule appears here as its own line — no hidden tax tables.
payslipDetail.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every deduction field.
payslipDetail.containerLabel: Payslip deduction lines. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.
